datum: V. Grace is poured into thy lips.
R. Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
in-tempore-paschali: V. Grace is poured into thy lips, Alleluia.
R. Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever, Alleluia.

datum: Blessed Mother * and inviolate Maiden! glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!
post-nativitatem: Herein is a great mystery of heirship; * the womb of her that knew not a man is become the temple of God: in taking of her flesh He was not defiled: all nations shall come and say, Glory be to Thee, O Lord!

datum: Thou Queen of Heaven, * rejoice! Alleluia. For He That thee for Son was given, Alleluia. As He promised is arisen, Alleluia. Mother, pray to Him for us, Alleluia.
Hail Mary, full of grace: * The Lord is with thee.
in-tempore-paschali: Hail Mary, full of grace: * The Lord is with thee, Alleluia.

incipit: O Holy Virgin Mary, happy indeed art thou, and right worthy of all praise,
responsum-i: For out of thee rose the Sun of righteousness,
versus: Pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all woman vowed to God. May all that are keeping this thine holy Feast-day feel the might of thine assistance.

datum: V. Blessed art thou among women.
R. And blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
in-tempore-paschali: V. Blessed art thou among women, Alleluia.
R. And blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Alleluia.

datum: O Blessed Mary, Mother of God, * Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any ensample before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ: pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.
